title: Producer question artifact v1
description: Written by a ba or dev producer, in place of its report, when it needs one owner decision that the request, the code and a sensible default cannot settle: docs/dev/producer-question-<task_id>-<role>.json. The orchestrator relays it with one AskUserQuestion (options become the dialog's options, default the recommended one) and re-dispatches the same role. The subagentstop artifact-contract hook checks task_id and role against the dispatch's obligation and that default is one of the option labels, which JSON Schema cannot express.
